items.question: How accurate are the AI-generated show notes?
items.answer: Our AI achieves 95%+ accuracy on most podcasts. The system is trained specifically on podcast content and continuously improves. You can always edit and customize the output to match your style.

items.question: What audio formats do you support?
items.answer: We support MP3, WAV, M4A, and most common audio formats. You can also provide YouTube URLs, podcast RSS feeds, or direct audio links.

items.question: Can I customize the output format?
items.answer: Yes! You can create custom templates, adjust tone and style, and even white-label the output for your brand. Pro and Agency plans include advanced customization options.

items.question: How does the WordPress integration work?
items.answer: Simply connect your WordPress site with your credentials, and you can publish show notes directly from CastLumen with one click. It handles formatting, images, and SEO automatically.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes! You can try our demo without signing up, and all paid plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee. The Free plan includes limited processing time each month.

items.question: How secure is my content?
items.answer: Very secure. We use enterprise-grade encryption, never store your audio files permanently, and are GDPR compliant. Your content is processed and then securely deleted.
